facts.fact: Netflix accounted for 7.8% of total US TV viewing in July 2026, per Nielsen's The Gauge as reported on the page.
facts.quote: Netflix accounted for 7.8% of total US TV viewing in July 2026, the latest month in Nielsen’s The Gauge.

facts.fact: YouTube reached a record 14.2% share of total US TV viewing in July 2026, according to TheWrap's report citing Nielsen data.
facts.quote: That share puts Netflix behind [YouTube’s record 14.2%]

facts.fact: The Motley Fool reports that streaming overall climbed to 49% of all TV time in July 2026.
facts.quote: streaming overall climbed to 49% of all TV time

facts.fact: TheWrap's report on the July 2026 Gauge puts broadcast's share of TV viewing at 19.5%.
facts.quote: puts broadcast at 19.5% and cable at 18.7%

facts.fact: Total US TV usage rose 2.2% from June to July 2026, according to Nielsen.
facts.quote: Total TV usage rose [2.2% from June]

facts.fact: The Nielsen July 2026 Gauge interval ran from June 29 to July 26, 2026.
facts.quote: which ran from June 29 to July 26, 2026

facts.fact: Nielsen's July 2026 Gauge release, published September 10, 2026, reports a 7.8% share for FOX as a media distributor, separate from Netflix's share.
facts.quote: published September 10, 2026, reports a 7.8% share for FOX as a media distributor

facts.fact: Netflix's share of total US TV viewing was 8.8% in July 2025, which the Motley Fool said was then a platform record.
facts.quote: July 2025: 8.8%, which was then a platform record, according to the Motley Fool.

facts.fact: Netflix's share of total US TV viewing was 9.0% in December 2025, which Nielsen named a platform-best share.
facts.quote: December 2025: 9.0%, which [Nielsen’s December 2025 Gauge report] named a platform-best share.

facts.fact: YouTube had 13.4% of total US TV viewing in July 2025, according to The Motley Fool.
facts.quote: YouTube had 13.4% in July 2025, 4.6 points ahead of Netflix’s 8.8%

facts.fact: YouTube's share was 6.4 points ahead of Netflix's in July 2026, according to The Motley Fool.
facts.quote: 14.2% in July 2026, 6.4 points ahead of Netflix’s 7.8%

facts.fact: The Motley Fool reports YouTube's ad revenue rose 13% year over year to around $11.1 billion in the second quarter of 2026.
facts.quote: YouTube’s ad revenue rose 13% year over year to around $11.1 billion in the second quarter of 2026

facts.fact: The May 2026 Gauge interval ran five weeks, from April 27 to May 31, 2026.
facts.quote: the May 2026 interval, for example, ran five weeks, from April 27 to May 31.

facts.fact: In the page's own arithmetic, the 'other' category (remaining after streaming, broadcast and cable) is 12.8% of July 2026 US TV viewing.
facts.quote: | Other (what remains after streaming, broadcast and cable) | 12.8% |

facts.fact: Adwave's published pricing sets daily budgets from $30 to $10,000, with no subscription or contract.
facts.quote: sets daily budgets from $30 to $10,000, with no subscription or contract.

facts.fact: Campaign creative is included in Adwave's pricing, and extra creative production is priced separately, for example at $6 per 15-second TV spot.
facts.quote: extra creation is priced separately, for example $6 per 15-second TV spot.

facts.fact: TikTok ads on Adwave start from $91 a day and require the user to turn TikTok on in Customize and connect a TikTok account.
facts.quote: TikTok starts from $91 a day and needs you to turn it on in Customize and connect your TikTok account.

facts.fact: Adwave lets users review their ads before adding a card.
facts.quote: You can review your ads before adding a card.

facts.fact: According to the Adwave FAQ, the budget, audience size, creative, and campaign settings determine which channels can run, along with content eligibility.
facts.quote: your budget and audience size, together with your creative and campaign settings, decide what can run, alongside content eligibility.

facts.fact: The Adwave FAQ states that Adwave does not guarantee sales or a return on spend.
facts.quote: does not guarantee sales or a return on spend

facts.fact: Adwave creates ads from a business's website and runs them on TV, search, social, and the web from one daily budget.
facts.quote: Adwave creates ads from your website and runs them on TV, search, social, and the web from one daily budget.
